objective.primaryRule: No primary and no roles are selected (diagnostic; adaptation AD1). The objects of study are the sealed earlier-cutoff procedures of 5B (L0 arm), the trading-session study and the shadow-eligibility study (B1, B2) and their sealed fold selections; their own frozen rules (NL0: the actual-profit role of each fold's qualified independent set) are reported, not re-applied.

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: No search proposals (diagnostic). backendEvaluations caps all fresh simulations: bounded replays of already-sealed configurations on development doors D19/D21/D23/D24 only (PROTOCOL.md §6: D3 <= 40, D4 <= 120, D6 <= 400, D7 <= 3,500, D8 <= 60). Record and cache reads are counted apart. FULL (2025-2026) is never opened.

deviations.description: no roles and no primary; nothing is selected; the audited studies' sealed roles and primaries are the objects of study
deviations.justification: diagnostic scope; brief: 'This is a diagnostic, root-cause investigation, not another optimization study'

deviations.description: stricter doors: FULL never opened; only development prefix doors, only to replay sealed selections on slices the audited studies already opened
deviations.justification: brief: 'No tuning against 2025-2026 ... not a pristine holdout'; a diagnosis of 2020-2024 walk-forward failures needs no 2025-2026 data

deviations.description: no search and no cutoff repeat; fresh simulations are bounded replays of sealed configurations (cap 4,200)
deviations.justification: standard §0.1: a diagnostic never searches; brief: 'Do not launch broad searches or parameter optimizations'

deviations.description: no new engine; each subject replayed with its own study's code and accepted only after reproducing its sealed fold record to the cent (gate G3)
deviations.justification: brief: 'Use the source version appropriate to each completed study'

deviations.description: no tuning benchmark; in-process replays in one contained systemd unit at a time; observed memory reported
deviations.justification: standard §6.3: diagnostics report observed use instead of benchmarking
